requirement.original: Restructure meal alternatives data format so alternatives are nested inside each meal type, not as separate top-level fields
requirement.clarified: Migrate meals.json from flat sibling format (lunch + lunch_alternatives at the day level) to nested format (lunch.primary + lunch.alternatives), updating schema, HTML generator merge logic, sync agent, and meals agent prompt to match
requirement.what: Structural refactor of meals.json data shape — alternatives nested under meal type object instead of stored as sibling keys at day level
requirement.why: Current flat format is a schema anti-pattern: related data fragmented across siblings, invisible to schema validation (additionalProperties: true silently permits *_alternatives keys), and requiring dynamic key construction (alt_key = f"{meal_type}_alternatives") at the read sites

root_cause_analysis.symptom: meal alternatives stored as sibling keys (lunch_alternatives) at day level, invisible to schema validation, requiring fragile dynamic key construction at every read site
root_cause_analysis.root_cause: When alternatives were added to meals.json, they were appended as parallel sibling fields at the day level rather than nested under the meal type object. The day_entry schema uses additionalProperties: true, so *_alternatives keys pass validation silently. Every consumer must independently reconstruct the relationship via string concatenation (alt_key = f"{meal_type}_alternatives").
root_cause_analysis.root_cause_commit: N/A - design improvement, not a regression
root_cause_analysis.why_introduced: Alternatives were likely added incrementally without a schema design review; appending a sibling key was the path of least resistance and did not require schema changes
root_cause_analysis.why_problematic: Three independent read sites must know about the naming convention; schema cannot enforce structural correctness; additionalProperties: true on day_entry masks any typo in the key name; sync agent bypasses alternatives entirely (no reference in sync-agent-data.py)
root_cause_analysis.timeline: Current state at time of this request; no regression event

development_approach.strategy: Four-file coordinated change: (1) update schema to define meal_slot wrapper, (2) update HTML generator to read from nested path with backward-compat fallback, (3) update sync agent to drill into .primary, (4) update meals agent prompt output example. Order matters: schema must be updated first so save.py accepts new format; HTML generator backward-compat fallback ensures existing data files continue to render during transition.

meals_schema.add_def: meal_slot: { type: object, properties: { primary: { $ref: meal_item }, alternatives: { type: array, items: { $ref: meal_item } } }, required: [primary], additionalProperties: false }
meals_schema.update_day_entry: breakfast/lunch/dinner properties change from $ref meal_item to $ref meal_slot
meals_schema.tighten_day_entry: consider additionalProperties: false after confirming no other unknown fields used in existing data

html_generator.alternatives_change: lines 580-617: replace alt_key lookup with alts = meal_slot.get('alternatives', day_meals.get(f'{meal_type}_alternatives', [])) [backward compat: fall back to old sibling key if nested not present]
